prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1096; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the course of 25 visits, care progressed along a typical rehabilitation pathway, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Orthopedic examination revealed positive findings on resisted testing and limited active elevation, while several other provider tests, including neurological screening and stability assessment, returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment involving the same shoulder region is documented in the patient history. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue the home exercise program as needed.
